final: WITH counts_by_dist_region AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM counts_by_dist_region) SELECT cdr.region, AVG(cdr.cnt) as avg_count, AVG(CAST(cdr.cnt AS FLOAT) / t.total_cnt) as avg_ratio FROM counts_by_dist_region cdr CROSS JOIN total t GROUP BY cdr.region ORDER BY cdr.region
